description: Reference closed lookups for world_tick POI picker. Rune's C# MissionStore.GetMissionsForLayer and any client-side picker mirror must match these tables exactly. Varn-locked 2026-05-17.
notes: These lookups are Varn-locked (slug set AND order). Do not reorder or change the slug set without a Varn ratification step. See consolidated spec varn-mission-ml-and-invariants-consolidated-2026-05-17.md §A.2 Q1.

VISIBLE_E2_DISTRICTS_BY_REGION._comment: M1 cap: only halfgate has E2-visible districts (3 districts, E2.1c lock). Other regions (brescaille, fendelune, veillemont, roches-closes) have no E2 districts in M1 — server falls back to e1.{region}. Extension to other regions is M2 scope.

MISSION_TYPE_DISTRICT_AFFINITY._comment: Order is the affinity distribution (Varn-locked). scout_route favours peripheral/transit zones (gateway first). parley_local favours civic/named zones (intramuros first). The seeded RNG picks from eligible (affinity ∩ visible) in this order.

pick_target_poi_contract.algorithm: 1. If region in VISIBLE_E2_DISTRICTS_BY_REGION: eligible = [d for d in MISSION_TYPE_DISTRICT_AFFINITY[mission_type] if d in VISIBLE_E2_DISTRICTS_BY_REGION[region]]; rng = Random(seed XOR 0xE2AFF1); chosen = rng.choice(eligible); return f'e2.{region}.{chosen}'. 2. Else: return f'e1.{region}'.
pick_target_poi_contract.determinism: Same (seed, mission_type, region) always yields same target_poi.

test_vectors.note: Exact district depends on RNG(0 XOR 0xE2AFF1).choice(['gateway','littoral','intramuros']). Run test_pick_target_poi_determinism for pinned value.
